column1: # Differences between kyo-email's reading of message ids and Stalwart mail-parser's, over resources/id.json at commit
# prints, in this format, each row missing here and each row here that no longer occurs.
# Columns, tab-separated: vector index from 0, header, the module's ids, Stalwart's ids (space-separated), reason.
# Backslash, tab, CR and LF in a value are written as \\, \t, \r and \n, and any other control character as \uXXXX.
# Reasons, each the first rule of MessageIdCodecStalwart.classify that holds:
#   CfwsInsideId: Stalwart keeps the white space and comments inside an obsolete msg-id; RFC 5322 section 4.5.4 says they are not part of the id, and the module removes them
